title: No-Cost EMI Explained: Who Really Pays the Interest?
description:
Is no-cost EMI really free? The bank still charges interest; the brand or seller pays it for you as an upfront discount (banks call this interest subvention). In SBI Card's own example, a ₹35,000 purchase (about $375) over 6 months at 14% carries ₹1,386 of interest, covered by a ₹1,386 discount, so the six EMIs add up to ₹35,000. But the discount doesn't cover the 18% GST on that interest (about ₹250 here), and many banks add a processing fee: HDFC Bank lists ₹99 to ₹699 + GST on EMI transactions. In this example that is roughly ₹366 to ₹1,074 extra. Compare with the price for paying in full before you choose EMI.

In 2013 the Reserve Bank of India told banks that in zero percent EMI schemes the interest is often camouflaged as a processing fee, and that "the very concept of zero percent interest is non-existent".

Sources: SBI Card No Cost EMI terms and worked example (sbicard.com, checked 25 Nov 2026); HDFC Bank EasyEMI on Credit Card page (checked 25 Nov 2026); Kotak Mahindra Bank, 'How to avail Amazon No Cost EMI' (10 Dec 2025); RBI circular RBI/2013-14/292 (17 Sept 2013). Dollar figure at ₹93.44 per $ (PTI, 18 Nov 2026). Fees and rates vary by bank, card and offer; check your offer's terms. Educational content, not financial advice.

es.title: EMI sin costo: ¿quién paga realmente los intereses?
es.summary: En la India, las cuotas "sin costo" sí cobran intereses: la marca los paga con un descuento. Pero tú pagas el 18% de GST sobre esos intereses y a veces una comisión.

pt.title: EMI sem custo: quem realmente paga os juros?
pt.summary: Na Índia, a parcela "sem custo" tem juros: a marca os paga com um desconto. Mas você paga 18% de GST sobre os juros e, muitas vezes, uma taxa de processamento.

hi.title: No-Cost EMI: असल में ब्याज कौन चुकाता है?
hi.summary: No-cost EMI में बैंक ब्याज लेता है, जिसे ब्रांड छूट देकर चुकाता है। लेकिन उस ब्याज पर 18% GST और प्रोसेसिंग फ़ीस आप देते हैं।

id.title: EMI Tanpa Biaya: Siapa yang Bayar Bunganya?
id.summary: Di India, cicilan "tanpa biaya" tetap berbunga: merek membayarnya lewat diskon. Tapi kamu tetap bayar GST 18% atas bunga itu dan sering juga biaya proses.

de.title: No-Cost-EMI: Wer zahlt wirklich die Zinsen?
de.summary: In Indien kosten "kostenlose" Raten trotzdem Zinsen: Die Marke zahlt sie per Rabatt. Die 18 % GST auf die Zinsen und oft eine Gebühr zahlst aber du.

fr.title: EMI sans frais : qui paie vraiment les intérêts ?
fr.summary: En Inde, les mensualités "sans frais" portent des intérêts, payés par la marque via une remise. Mais vous payez 18 % de GST sur ces intérêts et souvent des frais de dossier.

scenes.say: No-cost E-M-I still charges interest. Who actually pays it?
S-B-I Card's example: a thirty-five thousand rupee purchase, about three hundred seventy-five dollars.
At fourteen percent over six months, that's thirteen hundred eighty-six rupees interest.
The brand pays it, as an upfront discount. You still repay thirty-five thousand.
But here's the catch: the discount doesn't cover the tax.
You pay eighteen percent G-S-T on that interest: about two hundred fifty rupees.
